/travel/guadeloupe/gr-g1-day-1.metaTitle: GR-G1 Day 1 - Beginning the Trace des Alicés | Guadeloupe
/travel/guadeloupe/gr-g1-day-1.metaDescription: Leaving Sara's boat after a week on Marie Galante, which was a bittersweet way to start a hike across the length of Basse-Terre.
/travel/guadeloupe/gr-g1-day-1.ogImageAlt: the sea of green in the Guadeloupe jungle

/travel/guadeloupe/gr-g1-day-2.metaTitle: GR-G1 Day 2 - A Crazy Hike Through Guadeloupe
/travel/guadeloupe/gr-g1-day-2.metaDescription: Waking up in a hut with no windows, because glass breaks and open windows let the rats in. Then mud, jungle and steep ground.
/travel/guadeloupe/gr-g1-day-2.ogImageAlt: rebecca going down a steep muddy slope

/travel/guadeloupe/gr-g1-day-3.metaTitle: GR-G1 Day 3 - Reaching the Beach | Guadeloupe
/travel/guadeloupe/gr-g1-day-3.metaDescription: We overslept, understandably. Nothing had dried, so it was back into wet, filthy clothes, and then finally down to the beach.
/travel/guadeloupe/gr-g1-day-3.ogImageAlt: me looking out through a window in the jungle

/travel/guadeloupe/gr-g1-day-4.metaTitle: GR-G1 Day 4 - A Rest Day in Guadeloupe
/travel/guadeloupe/gr-g1-day-4.metaDescription: Awake at six and unable to fall asleep again, so out with the camera. A rest day of orange clouds, palm trees and doing nothing.
/travel/guadeloupe/gr-g1-day-4.ogImageAlt: orange clouds moving over the sea and palm trees

/travel/guadeloupe/gr-g1-day-5.metaTitle: GR-G1 Day 5 - The Carbet Falls | Guadeloupe
/travel/guadeloupe/gr-g1-day-5.metaDescription: Up early for a long day. Out through Capesterre-Belle-Eau, past a friendly man carrying a machete, and on to the Carbet Falls.
/travel/guadeloupe/gr-g1-day-5.ogImageAlt: the first carbet fall showing itself through the clouds

/travel/guadeloupe/gr-g1-day-6.metaTitle: GR-G1 Day 6 - La Soufrière Volcano | Guadeloupe
/travel/guadeloupe/gr-g1-day-6.metaDescription: Up early again for La Soufrière, the highest mountain on the island. We had been warned the way up was hard, and it was.

/travel/guadeloupe/port-luis.metaTitle: Surfing in Port Luis | Guadeloupe Travel Story
/travel/guadeloupe/port-luis.metaDescription: After a long stretch at Tikazalou I went over to the other side of the island for the surf at Port Louis. It delivered.
/travel/guadeloupe/port-luis.ogImageAlt: surfing in Port Luis at sunset

/travel/guadeloupe/tikazalou-1.metaDescription: One night in Malendure after the GR-G1, then a tip from Lou, somebody we met hitchhiking, led us to the hostel at Tikazalou.
/travel/guadeloupe/tikazalou-1.ogImageAlt: view from Nathalies home over pigeon island

/travel/guadeloupe/tikazalou-2.metaTitle: Diving in the Caribbean Sea | Guadeloupe
/travel/guadeloupe/tikazalou-2.metaDescription: Juliane asked around the hostel whether anybody wanted to go diving. I thought about it for a while and then said hell yeah.

/travel/guadeloupe/tikazalou-3.metaDescription: The weeks at Tikazalou were punctuated by small excursions. Saut d'Acomat, a slackline strung up somewhere and a piano.

/travel/guadeloupe/tikazalou-4.metaTitle: Plage du Bosco & Hidden Gems | Guadeloupe
/travel/guadeloupe/tikazalou-4.metaDescription: The days at Tikazalou blur into each other. Every so often one turns into a proper trip, like the one out to Plage du Bosco.
/travel/guadeloupe/tikazalou-4.ogImageAlt: long exposrue of waves washing on the beach of Plage du Bosco

/travel/guadeloupe/tikazalou-5.metaDescription: A day out to break the Tikazalou routine, going north into Basse-Terre after at least four different waterfalls.
/travel/guadeloupe/tikazalou-5.ogImageAlt: majestic waterfall in the middle of the jungle

/travel/guadeloupe/tikazalou-6.metaDescription: Somewhere far away and awkward to reach that people at the hostel described as a literal paradise. So we went to look.

/travel/dominica/boiling-lake-and-middle.metaDescription: Up early, cereal and milk at Le Petit Paradis, then the long walk out to Boiling Lake and Middleham Falls. A hard day.
/travel/dominica/boiling-lake-and-middle.ogImageAlt: the Boiling lake in the middle of Dominica

/travel/dominica/jacky-and-spanny-falls-.metaDescription: Viola and I set out to find as many waterfalls as we could, hitchhiking and taking buses. Salton Falls came first.
/travel/dominica/jacky-and-spanny-falls-.ogImageAlt: the Emerald pools waterfall with a person meditating sitting next to it

/travel/dominica/lakes-and-trafalgar-fal.metaDescription: Waking up in Wotton Waven with new mosquito bites. Freshwater and Boeri Lakes, then Trafalgar Falls, hitchhiking in between.
/travel/dominica/lakes-and-trafalgar-fal.ogImageAlt: view onto the Freshwater Lake in Dominica and the surrounding mountains

/travel/dominica/soufriere.metaTitle: Soufrière Village Life | Dominica Travel Story
/travel/dominica/soufriere.metaDescription: Life is nothing but sweet mangos right now. Soufrière is a sleepy fishing village where everybody knows everybody and plays dominoes.
/travel/dominica/soufriere.ogImageAlt: fishing boats at sunset floating in the waves near Soufriere

/travel/dominica/wavine-cyrique-waterfal.metaDescription: Hitchhiking out from Soufrière took a while, and the way in needed local directions plus Organic Maps. Worth it for the beach.
/travel/dominica/wavine-cyrique-waterfal.ogImageAlt: the Wavine Cyrique waterfall as seen from the distance

/travel/martinique-2024/anse-de-couleuvr.metaTitle: Anse de Couleuvre & Habitacion Cerón | Martinique
/travel/martinique-2024/anse-de-couleuvr.metaDescription: Last day on Martinique, so I made it a full one. Hitchhiking north to a waterfall near Anse de Couleuvre and the tree at Habitation Cerón.
/travel/martinique-2024/anse-de-couleuvr.ogImageAlt: Rico standing in front of the giant Zamana tree in Habitacion Cerón

/travel/martinique-2024/fort-da-france-a.metaDescription: I liked Martinique straight away because of the architecture in Fort-de-France. Roaming a new city with a camera is hard to beat.
/travel/martinique-2024/fort-da-france-a.ogImageAlt: the Schoelcher library during the day from the side

/travel/martinique-2024/tombolo-and-anse.metaTitle: Tombolo of Sainte Marie & Anse du Sinai | Martinique
/travel/martinique-2024/tombolo-and-anse.metaDescription: Hitchhiking up the north-east coast. The Tombolo sandbank at Sainte-Marie, Anse du Sinaï and a rum distillery along the way.
/travel/martinique-2024/tombolo-and-anse.ogImageAlt: two people walking over the tombolo sandbank

/travel/portugal-2024/fishermans-trail-d.metaTitle: Fisherman's Trail Day 1 - Arriving in Sines
/travel/portugal-2024/fishermans-trail-d.metaDescription: Arriving in Sines, a small town by the ocean. The Origens Hostel was lovely and, at 35 euro a night, not exactly cheap.
/travel/portugal-2024/fishermans-trail-d.ogImageAlt: a nighttime street in Sines Portugal

/travel/portugal-2024/fishermans-trail-d.metaTitle: Fisherman's Trail Day 2 - Walking to Porto Covo
/travel/portugal-2024/fishermans-trail-d.metaDescription: Out of the hostel early with somebody I had just met. A long way to Porto Covo, and a whole day of conversation and cliffs.
A very slow day. Stomach cramps kept me in bed until the afternoon, when I felt well enough to walk out to the lighthouse.

/travel/portugal-2024/fishermans-trail-d.metaTitle: Fisherman's Trail Day 4 - Camping in the Dunes
/travel/portugal-2024/fishermans-trail-d.metaDescription: Walking again after two days flat on my back with stomach flu. Up early, a long stretch and a tent pitched in the dunes.
/travel/portugal-2024/fishermans-trail-d.ogImageAlt: fisherman sitting quietly on a cliff

/travel/portugal-2024/fishermans-trail-d.metaTitle: Fisherman's Trail Day 5 - A Beautiful Last Day
/travel/portugal-2024/fishermans-trail-d.metaDescription: Waking up freezing in the dunes, condensation dripping off the tent walls and the wind pulling at the fabric. The last day.
/travel/portugal-2024/fishermans-trail-d.ogImageAlt: stairway with a man standing there looking towards the rocks and waves, long exposure

/travel/portugal-2024/lagos-cuddle-house.metaTitle: Lagos Cuddle House | Portugal Travel Story
/travel/portugal-2024/lagos-cuddle-house.metaDescription: A stop in Lagos, down in the Algarve. Golden cliffs, the Atlantic and not very much of a schedule to speak of.
/travel/portugal-2024/lagos-cuddle-house.ogImageAlt: the sea of green in the Guadeloupe jungle

/travel/portugal-2024/the-garden.metaDescription: Days spent at The Garden in the Portuguese countryside. Not much happening, which was more or less the point of going.
/travel/portugal-2024/the-garden.ogImageAlt: the sea of green in the Guadeloupe jungle

/travel/sailing-2024/cape-verde.metaDescription: Coming into port through thick morning mist, with only the mountaintops showing. Then piano, mandinga, cachupa and a lot of waiting.

/travel/sailing-2024/pepa-canaries-to-ca.metaTitle: Sailing from Canaries to Cape Verde on Pepa
/travel/sailing-2024/pepa-canaries-to-ca.metaDescription: I found a boat. A maybe turned into do you want to sail with us, and the answer was obvious. Gran Canaria to Cape Verde on the Pepa.

/travel/thinking-of-dave/1-tod-tangier.metaTitle: Thinking of Dave - Tangier | Sailing Story
/travel/thinking-of-dave/1-tod-tangier.metaDescription: A dormitory bed in the middle of the Medina in Tangier, where the narrow streets seem to move when you are not looking.

/travel/thinking-of-dave/2-tod-tangier-t.metaTitle: Tangier to Lanzarote | Thinking of Dave
/travel/thinking-of-dave/2-tod-tangier-t.metaDescription: Waking up full of excitement. Today is the day we leave the harbour and head for the Canaries, very early in the morning.

/travel/thinking-of-dave/3-tod-marina-la.metaTitle: Marina Lanzarote | Thinking of Dave Sailing
/travel/thinking-of-dave/3-tod-marina-la.metaDescription: Restaurants, washing machines, real bathrooms and soft music down the whole pier. A very civilised place to arrive from the sea.

/travel/thinking-of-dave/4-tod-lanzarote.metaTitle: Lanzarote to Gran Canaria | Thinking of Dave
/travel/thinking-of-dave/4-tod-lanzarote.metaDescription: Leaving Lanzarote at midday, because it is a bit under a day of sailing and we want to reach Gran Canaria in the morning.

/travel/thinking-of-dave/5-tod-gran-cana.metaTitle: Gran Canaria | Thinking of Dave Sailing Story
/travel/thinking-of-dave/5-tod-gran-cana.metaDescription: Mostly about the crew of the Thinking of Dave. Deep friendships form very fast when you live on a small boat together.

/travel/transat/day-0-preparing-to-leave.metaTitle: Transatlantic Day 0 - Preparing to Leave Mindelo
/travel/transat/day-0-preparing-to-leave.metaDescription: Buying food. Enormous quantities of it, plus drinking water, beer and Coca-Cola, before leaving Mindelo tomorrow morning.
/travel/transat/day-0-preparing-to-leave.ogImageAlt: christian grinning on boat with supplies

/travel/transat/day-1-leaving-mindelo.metaDescription: Out of the harbour at Mindelo and into the Atlantic. Everything stocked up, and rather a lot of people on board.
/travel/transat/day-1-leaving-mindelo.ogImageAlt: the motley fleet crew of the transatlantic journey

/travel/transat/day-2-out-at-sea.metaDescription: The feeling starts to sink in that this boat is where we will be spending the next two and a half weeks together.

/travel/transat/day-3-fish-or-no-fish.metaTitle: Transatlantic Day 3 - Fish or No Fish
/travel/transat/day-3-fish-or-no-fish.metaDescription: The lines go out every morning, because fish hunt at sunrise and sunset. A beer can serves as the bite alarm.
/travel/transat/day-3-fish-or-no-fish.ogImageAlt: the makeshift fishing alarm beer can contraption

/travel/transat/day-4-fish-for-real.metaTitle: Transatlantic Day 4 - We Caught a Fish!
/travel/transat/day-4-fish-for-real.metaDescription: Christian screaming for help got everybody on deck. Two fish, one on each line, at exactly the same moment.
/travel/transat/day-4-fish-for-real.ogImageAlt: christian happily showing the first fish we caught

/travel/transat/day-5-taking-apart-the-w.metaTitle: Transatlantic Day 5 - Fixing the Wind Autopilot
/travel/transat/day-5-taking-apart-the-w.metaDescription: My first fish, sashimi with soy sauce, leftover noodles for lunch, then taking the wind autopilot apart and practising knots.

/travel/transat/day-6-seagrass-fishing.metaDescription: Six days at sea and twelve more to Guadeloupe. Written late at night on another watch, in between hauling in seagrass.

/travel/transat/day-7-crazy-hats.metaTitle: Transatlantic Day 7 - Crazy Hats at Sea
/travel/transat/day-7-crazy-hats.metaDescription: Christian turned the stale bread into Scheiterhaufen, which is old bread with sugar, butter and eggs baked in the oven.
/travel/transat/day-7-crazy-hats.ogImageAlt: things you do on a boat when there is nothing else to do

/travel/transat/day-8-sunrise-magic.metaDescription: The morning watch to myself, a very good sunrise, French Kiwi Juice in the headphones and nothing to do but watch.

/travel/transat/day-9-sailing-maneuvers.metaDescription: Woken in the middle of the night by Rebecca shouting about the autopilot. I assumed I had dreamt it, then went to look.
/travel/transat/day-9-sailing-maneuvers.ogImageAlt: how far we have come marked on a map

/travel/transat/day-10-dolphins.metaTitle: Transatlantic Day 10 – Dolphins in the Atlantic
/travel/transat/day-10-dolphins.metaDescription: One of the best days of the whole crossing. It started with a loud bang on the hull waking me up, and improved from there.
/travel/transat/day-10-dolphins.ogImageAlt: rebecca happily pointing to the dolphins

/travel/transat/day-11-christians-ciabat.metaTitle: Transatlantic Day 11 - Baking Bread at Sea
/travel/transat/day-11-christians-ciabat.metaDescription: A lot of small good things in one day. I wrote this on the night watch, still grinning about it. Christian baked ciabatta.

/travel/transat/day-12-surfing-the-waves.metaDescription: Up for the sunrise after the morning watch. The sea takes on a golden pattern that I could sit and stare at for hours.
/travel/transat/day-12-surfing-the-waves.ogImageAlt: me steering the boat smiling happily

/travel/transat/day-13-a-day-of-reading.metaTitle: Transatlantic Day 13 - A Day of Reading
/travel/transat/day-13-a-day-of-reading.metaDescription: The most uneventful day so far. Nothing broke, nothing to steer, no sail changes. Everybody quietly read and wrote instead.
/travel/transat/day-13-a-day-of-reading.ogImageAlt: my kindle the primary source of entertainment

/travel/transat/day-14-double-rainbows.metaDescription: The morning watch, and dark ominous clouds about an hour and a half into it. Then two rainbows at once over the water.

/travel/transat/day-15-chasing-the-storm.metaDescription: Off watch at 04:30 and straight back up again, because I could hear the wind picking up outside the whole boat.
/travel/transat/day-15-chasing-the-storm.ogImageAlt: Christian and Rebecca steering the boat through the storm

/travel/transat/day-16-more-stormy-weath.metaDescription: More fast-moving cloud and stormy weather. The wind shifted enough that we changed to a mainsail and foresail combination.

/travel/transat/day-17-swimming-in-the-d.metaTitle: Transatlantic Day 17 - Swimming in the Deep End
/travel/transat/day-17-swimming-in-the-d.metaDescription: The sun rising as the moon set, almost no wind and a completely flat sea. So we swam, with kilometres of water underneath.

/travel/transat/day-18-land-in-sight.metaDescription: The last day. We reach Guadeloupe around midday and anchor at a small spot in the middle of nowhere.

/travel/colombia-2024/1-bogota-arrival-a.metaTitle: Arriving in Bogota - First Arepas & Cumbia
/travel/colombia-2024/1-bogota-arrival-a.metaDescription: Landing in Bogotá for the first time. Couchsurfing with Sisu, the first arepas and a night out dancing to very good cumbia.
/travel/colombia-2024/1-bogota-arrival-a.ogImageAlt: the sea of green in the Guadeloupe jungle

/travel/colombia-2024/2-bogota-museo-del.metaTitle: Bogota - Museo del Oro, Food & Chess
/travel/colombia-2024/2-bogota-museo-del.metaDescription: The Museo del Oro, a lot of very good Colombian food and playing chess in the streets of Bogotá.
/travel/colombia-2024/2-bogota-museo-del.ogImageAlt: the sea of green in the Guadeloupe jungle

/travel/colombia-2024/3-bogota-ciclovia-.metaDescription: Sunday in Bogotá, when the city shuts its streets for the Ciclovía. Calling Marc, writing the newsletter, eating extremely well.
/travel/colombia-2024/3-bogota-ciclovia-.ogImageAlt: the sea of green in the Guadeloupe jungle

/travel/colombia-2024/4-bicycle-hunting.metaDescription: Going shop to shop across Bogotá looking for a bicycle that would survive the Andes. Decathlon included.

/travel/colombia-2024/5-bicycle-gear-res.metaDescription: A day at Tribu Bikes reading up on touring setups. Which frame, which bags and which tyres for Colombian mountain roads.

/travel/colombia-2024/6-bogota-found-a-b.metaDescription: Agua panela and homemade arepas for breakfast, an Uber motorcycle across town, Monserrate and finally an actual bicycle.

/travel/colombia-2024/7-fusagasuga.metaDescription: A bus down to Fusagasugá for saddlebags, and an afternoon with Marcela, who is the living definition of a power woman.

/travel/colombia-2024/8-returning-from-f.metaDescription: Back to Bogotá from Fusagasugá with the saddlebags. That was the last piece of gear still missing.

/travel/colombia-2024/9-buying-the-bicyc.metaTitle: Buying the Bicycle & Partying Hard | Bogota
/travel/colombia-2024/9-buying-the-bicyc.metaDescription: The day the touring bicycle actually got bought. Then a long meal with friends and a considerably longer night out.

/travel/colombia-2024/10-resting-day-and.metaTitle: Last Rest Day & Purchases Before Cycling
/travel/colombia-2024/10-resting-day-and.metaDescription: One more rest day in Bogotá. Breakfast with eggs, arepas and pineapple tea, then a last run to Decathlon for the missing gear.

/travel/colombia-2024/day-1-bogota-to-fu.metaDescription: First day on the bike. Meeting Manuel at 8am and riding out through the hectic, chaotic streets of Bogotá towards Fusagasugá.

/travel/colombia-2024/day-1-plus-another.metaTitle: Resting at a Finca Near Fusagasugá | Colombia
/travel/colombia-2024/day-1-plus-another.metaDescription: I meant to stay one day. Three weeks later I was still at the finca, with rivers, birds, drone flights, coworking and good coffee.

/travel/colombia-2024/day-2-fusa-to-gira.metaDescription: Saying goodbye to Tania, with the dengue fever finally gone. Fusagasugá to Girardot, some surprise waterfalls, a lot of highway.

/travel/colombia-2024/day-3-girardot-to-.metaDescription: Girardot to Ibagué, most of it on the main highway. Then a side road with no cars on it, which was the whole point of this.

/travel/colombia-2024/day-4-ibague-to-to.metaTitle: Cycling Ibagué to Toché - Rain & Hot Springs
/travel/colombia-2024/day-4-ibague-to-to.metaDescription: Out of Ibagué in grey morning fog with nobody else awake. Then rainclouds, tunnels, muddy climbs and hot springs at the end.

/travel/colombia-2024/day-5-toche-to-sal.metaTitle: Cycling Toché to Salento - Palm Forests
/travel/colombia-2024/day-5-toche-to-sal.metaDescription: Packing the tent in the dark, agua panela and bread from the woman running the place in Toché, then steep climbs and 18 km downhill.

/travel/colombia-2024/day-6-salento-to-c.metaDescription: Waking up refreshed in a tent again. Breakfast with my cousin in Salento, then the Cocora valley and its tourist crowds.

/travel/colombia-2024/day-7-circasia-to-.metaTitle: Circasia to Filandia - Rolling Hills | Colombia
/travel/colombia-2024/day-7-circasia-to-.metaDescription: Waking up in a horse stable, agua panela from the finca owners, then rolling hills to Filandia and a French cyclist for company.

/travel/colombia-2024/day-8-resting-at-j.metaTitle: Rest Day Near Pereira | Colombia Cycling
/travel/colombia-2024/day-8-resting-at-j.metaDescription: An unspectacular but badly needed rest day near Pereira. Cooking, calling people, doing very little after a week of climbing.

/travel/colombia-2024/day-9-up-towards-t.metaTitle: Towards Los Nevados - Pereira & Rain | Colombia
/travel/colombia-2024/day-9-up-towards-t.metaDescription: A slow start at Jaque's place, washing the bike and waiting on a Warmshowers reply. Then the chaos of Pereira, and rain.

/travel/colombia-2024/day-10-into-the-na.metaTitle: Los Nevados National Park & Laguna Otún
/travel/colombia-2024/day-10-into-the-na.metaDescription: Alarm at 5:30, out of the finca at first light, then a long climb into Los Nevados up to Laguna Otún. And some very silly park rules.

/travel/colombia-2024/day-11-descending-.metaTitle: Descending to Manizales - Flat Tire Drama
/travel/colombia-2024/day-11-descending-.metaDescription: Up at 5am for a 40 km descent to Manizales. A flat tyre in puma territory on the way down, and paradise at the bottom of it.

/travel/colombia-2024/day-12-14-resting-.metaTitle: Resting Days in Manizales | Colombia Cycling
/travel/colombia-2024/day-12-14-resting-.metaDescription: Three rest days in Manizales, camping in somebody's backyard and letting my legs recover before heading back up.

/travel/colombia-2024/day-15-up-to-the-g.metaTitle: Back Towards the Nevados | Colombia Cycling
/travel/colombia-2024/day-15-up-to-the-g.metaDescription: Leaving Manizales for Los Nevados again, this time on the road cyclists are allowed to use. Which means climbing all of it.

/travel/colombia-2024/day-16-los-nevados.metaTitle: Nevado del Ruiz & the Páramo | Colombia
/travel/colombia-2024/day-16-los-nevados.metaDescription: Waking up in the ruins I had camped in, too excited to wait for the alarm. Then up through the páramo towards the Nevado del Ruiz.

/travel/colombia-2024/day-17-murillo-to-.metaDescription: Woken by dogs barking around the tent, then 40 km of mountainside heading down towards Cambao. Very little pedalling required.

/travel/colombia-2024/day-18-cambao-to-j.metaTitle: Cambao to Jerusalén - Tire Troubles | Colombia
/travel/colombia-2024/day-18-cambao-to-j.metaDescription: Tired legs, mosquito bites from the night before, and tyre trouble the whole way to Jerusalén. A kind family sorted out the rest.

/travel/colombia-2024/day-18-19-cambao-t.metaTitle: Cambao to Jerusalén & Tire Problems | Colombia
/travel/colombia-2024/day-18-19-cambao-t.metaDescription: Two days between Cambao and Jerusalén, mostly spent on flat tyres and on the people who stopped to help fix them.

/travel/colombia-2024/day-19-jerusalen-g.metaTitle: Fixing Tires in Jerusalén | Colombia Cycling
/travel/colombia-2024/day-19-jerusalen-g.metaDescription: A rest day in Jerusalén hunting down spare tyres. The remainder of it went on painting and reading.

/travel/colombia-2024/day-20-cycling-bac.metaTitle: 100km in One Day Back to Fusa | Colombia
/travel/colombia-2024/day-20-cycling-bac.metaDescription: Over 100 km in a single day to get back to Fusagasugá. The longest ride of the trip and the last one before a proper rest.

/travel/crete/day-1-arriving-in-crete.metaTitle: Day 1 - Arriving in Crete | Greece Travel
/travel/crete/day-1-arriving-in-crete.metaDescription: Ryanair to Heraklion, then walking out of the airport past fig trees and grapevines. It had been a long time since the last trip.

/travel/crete/day-2-heraklion.metaDescription: Meditation, exercise and writing, then the walk down from the hotel to the beach. A first proper look around Heraklion.

/travel/crete/day-3-agios-nikolaos.metaTitle: Day 3 – Agios Nikolaos | Crete Travel Story
/travel/crete/day-3-agios-nikolaos.metaDescription: Leaving the beach with the aeroplanes going over it. Bread with tzatziki and hummus for breakfast, then on to Agios Nikolaos.

/travel/crete/day-4-leaving-agios-nikola.metaDescription: Alarm at 5:45 for the sunrise, and worth it even half asleep. Then packing up and carrying on further east along the coast.

/travel/crete/day-5-kalydon.metaDescription: Leaving Kalliopi's little hotel and heading back north of Agios Nikolaos, out to the island we had scouted the day before.

/travel/crete/day-6-ierapetra.metaDescription: Most of the night went on photographing stars, and sleeping outside means the sunrise gets you up anyway. Ierapetra by daylight.

/travel/crete/day-7-arriving-in-chrissi.metaTitle: Day 7 - Arriving on Chrissi Island | Crete
/travel/crete/day-7-arriving-in-chrissi.metaDescription: An hour by boat south of Ierapetra. Chrissi had been sold to us as paradise, and as the best night sky anywhere nearby.

/travel/crete/day-8-another-day-in-chris.metaTitle: Day 8 - Another Day on Chrissi Island | Crete
/travel/crete/day-8-another-day-in-chris.metaDescription: A second day on Chrissi. Not nearly enough sleep again, but early morning on a remote island makes up for a lot.

/travel/crete/day-9-leaving-chrissi.metaDescription: Out for the sunrise on Chrissi one more time before the boat back. It is hard to get tired of that particular view.

/travel/crete/day-10-mirtos-and-mithi.metaTitle: Day 10 – Mirtos and Mithi Villages | Crete
/travel/crete/day-10-mirtos-and-mithi.metaDescription: After two nights on the island with barely any sleep, a real bed in Mirtos felt like heaven. No mice and no police this time.

/travel/crete/day-11-hiking-the-mithi-go.metaTitle: Day 11 - Hiking the Mithi Gorge | Crete
/travel/crete/day-11-hiking-the-mithi-go.metaDescription: Waking up groggy in an olive grove covered in mosquito bites, then breakfast up in Mithi and a walk through the gorge.

/travel/crete/day-12-an-uneventful-day-i.metaTitle: Day 12 - A Quiet Day in Mirtos | Crete
/travel/crete/day-12-an-uneventful-day-i.metaDescription: Swimming at sunrise, meditation, breakfast and then not very much else at all. Some travel days are simply like that.

/travel/crete/day-13-a-slow-day-spent-in.metaTitle: Day 13 - A Slow Day in Tsoutsouros | Crete
/travel/crete/day-13-a-slow-day-spent-in.metaDescription: Another night in Tsoutsouros to catch up with things. Reading, podcasts and doing almost nothing for a whole day.

/travel/crete/day-14-kalamaki.metaDescription: Training at the Hotel San Georgio in Tsoutsouros, then packing up and hitching along the coast towards Kalamaki.

/travel/crete/day-15-visiting-matala.metaDescription: Breakfast and meditation in Kalamaki, then a day trip over to Matala for the caves and whatever is left of the hippies.

/travel/crete/day-16-sleeping-at-the-bea.metaTitle: Day 16 - Sleeping on Kommos Beach | Crete
/travel/crete/day-16-sleeping-at-the-bea.metaDescription: Not much sleep on Kommos beach. Wind, moonlight coming through the cedar tree and something biting me all night long.

/travel/crete/day-17-going-to-fourfouras.metaDescription: Waking up to waves at Kommos, watching the sunrise from a sandy air mattress, then turning inland towards Fourfouras.

/travel/crete/day-18-hiking-the-psilorit.metaDescription: Alarm at 4:55 to climb Psiloritis, the highest mountain on Crete at 2,456 m. Groggy at the bottom, much less so at the top.

/travel/crete/day-19-mountain-villages.metaTitle: Day 19 – Mountain Villages of Central Crete
/travel/crete/day-19-mountain-villages.metaDescription: A slower day after the summit. A short walk over to Meronas through stone villages and olive groves, after a very good sleep.

/travel/crete/day-20-hitching-from-meron.metaDescription: A walk up the hill before Marc woke up, then a plunge into the hotel pool, then thumbs out on the road away from Meronas.

/travel/crete/day-21-another-day-in-hora.metaTitle: Day 21 – Hora Sfakion | Crete Travel Story
/travel/crete/day-21-another-day-in-hora.metaDescription: A badly slept night and a morning spent stewing over a WhatsApp group and an email to the ESA team, in a town under huge cliffs.

/travel/crete/day-22-hora-sfakion.metaTitle: Day 22 - More Days in Hora Sfakion | Crete
/travel/crete/day-22-hora-sfakion.metaDescription: A good night on a good sleeping spot, then a morning swim in the Libyan Sea before meditation and packing up again.

/travel/crete/day-23-spending-a-day-in-a.metaDescription: A workout and a swim to start the day. The wind from the night was still shaking the olive trees, and had got stronger.

/travel/crete/day-24-polyrizos.metaDescription: A stop in Polyrizos, a very small village on the south coast, close to the end of a month spent on the island.

/travel/crete/day-25-polyrizos-then-agia.metaDescription: Polyrizos to Agia Gallini, then all the way back across to Heraklion. The trip slowly winding itself up.

/travel/crete/day-26-the-last-day-in-cre.metaTitle: Day 26 - The Last Day in Crete | Greece
/travel/crete/day-26-the-last-day-in-cre.metaDescription: The last day in Heraklion was boring and lazy. I spent almost all of it in the hotel room watching YouTube videos.

/travel/india-2018/varanasi.metaTitle: Varanasi - The Holy City at the Ganges | India
/travel/india-2018/varanasi.metaDescription: One of the most profound and transforming things I have ever done. Just after the rains, with the Ganges over most of the ghats.

/travel/india-2020/1-mumbai-i.metaDescription: Being on the road after almost a year without leaving Berlin is exhilarating. Written from a hostel bunk bed in Mumbai.

/travel/india-2020/2-mumbai-ii.metaDescription: A horrible night. I woke up over and over and could not get back to sleep, because Mumbai simply does not go quiet.

/travel/india-2020/3-mumbai-iii.metaDescription: Better sleep until about 6am, when somebody in the hostel took a shower and then played music off his phone at full volume.

/travel/india-2020/4-kaladay-i.metaTitle: Kalady Day 1 – Arriving in Kerala | India 2020
/travel/india-2020/4-kaladay-i.metaDescription: Finally rested. The jet lag is wearing off and this place is quiet, with nobody walking around or playing music at night.

/travel/india-2020/5-kalady-ii.metaTitle: Kalady Day 2 – Village Life in Kerala | India 2020
/travel/india-2020/5-kalady-ii.metaDescription: The alarm goes early, because the evening light the day before was so good that I want the fields of Kerala in the morning too.

/travel/india-2020/6-kalady-iii.metaTitle: Kalady Day 3 – South Indian Life | India 2020
/travel/india-2020/6-kalady-iii.metaDescription: Ben knocks and opens the door because I have slept far too late. Dressing in a hurry to be ready for the ceremonies of the day.

/travel/india-2020/7-kalady-iv.metaTitle: Kalady Day 4 – Last Day in Kerala | India 2020
/travel/india-2020/7-kalady-iv.metaDescription: The alarm goes very early and once again I have not slept nearly enough, but I get up anyway to go and see the sunrise.

/travel/india-2020/8-munnar-i.metaDescription: Slept very late, because the rice paddies the day before were so good that I stayed up half the night writing about them.

/travel/india-2020/9-munnar-ii.metaTitle: Munnar Day 2 | Kerala Hill Country, India 2020
/travel/india-2020/9-munnar-ii.metaDescription: 5am on the phone clock, still drowsy, but out with the camera and backpack as quietly as possible to catch the sunrise.

/travel/india-2020/10-munnar-iii.metaDescription: Last day in Munnar. I asked Dani from the hostel, who rides a Royal Enfield around India, whether I could join him up to Top Station.

/travel/india-2020/11-bangalore-i.metaDescription: The bus operator's voice wakes me up. A night of being shaken around on a bus, and surprisingly good sleep, then Bangalore.

/travel/india-2020/12-bangalore-ii.metaDescription: Waking up neither early nor late, which is a good thing in itself. A second day spent walking around Bangalore.

/travel/india-2020/13-bangalore-iii.metaDescription: After spending most of the previous day inside the hostel I got on a bus and went out to see the rest of the city instead.

/travel/india-2022/1-kolkata.metaTitle: Kolkata – The City of Joy | India 2022
/travel/india-2022/1-kolkata.metaDescription: Kolkata is called the city of joy for good reason. People smile and seem genuinely happy. A short stay, and I want to go back.

/travel/india-2022/2-traveling-to-darjee.metaDescription: Leaving Kolkata was sad. Sunil and his family had grown on me in a few days, and they dropped me at the train station.

/travel/india-2022/3-darjeeling-i.metaDescription: Tea fields and clouds sitting on rolling hills, with mountain forest and small villages in between. Darjeeling is mesmerising.

/travel/india-2022/4-darjeeling-ii.metaDescription: More time in Darjeeling. Tea estates, monasteries and Kanchenjunga whenever the clouds let you actually see it.

/travel/india-2022/5-gangtok-sikkim.metaDescription: Gangtok, the capital of Sikkim. Monasteries, mountains and a culture that feels quite unlike the rest of India.

/travel/india-2022/6-shillong.metaTitle: Shillong – Scotland of the East | India 2022
/travel/india-2022/6-shillong.metaDescription: The capital of Meghalaya. Hectic in the middle, quiet out in the suburbs, with a good market and better food.

/travel/india-2022/7-cherrapunji.metaDescription: Cherrapunji, or Sohra to the Khasi people who live there, in a state whose name translates as the abode of the clouds.

/travel/india-2022/8-tyrna-and-nongriat.metaDescription: Tyrna is where the road ends. Over 3000 steps lead down from there to the rivers and the jungle village of Nongriat.

/travel/india-2022/9-nongriat.metaDescription: Nongriat is a small village in the middle of nowhere in the jungle hills of Meghalaya. Two days of waterfalls and green.

/travel/india-2022/10-nohkalikai-falls.metaDescription: Rain all night, so packing up damp. Saying goodbye to Byron at the Serenity homestay, then out to Nohkalikai Falls.

/travel/india-2022/11-manali.metaDescription: Arriving in Manali, where most Himalayan trips through Himachal Pradesh start. Sorting things out before heading further up.

/travel/india-2022/12-walk-to-mahri.metaTitle: Walk to Mahri | Himachal Pradesh, India 2022
/travel/india-2022/12-walk-to-mahri.metaDescription: Awake at 4:55, five minutes before the alarm. Packing the backpack in the dark and then walking up towards Mahri.

/travel/india-2022/13-chhatru.metaDescription: Far too little sleep but somehow refreshed. The orange sunrise I had been looking forward to stayed hidden behind cloud.

/travel/india-2022/14-hiking.metaTitle: Himalayan Hiking in Himachal Pradesh | India 2022
/travel/india-2022/14-hiking.metaDescription: Alone with the birds. It starts snowing, and a truck far off plus two motorcyclists are the only other people all morning.

/travel/india-2022/15-chandratal.metaDescription: Awake just before the alarm and still tired, but the headaches are gone. Probably the medicine the Indian couple gave me.

/travel/india-2022/16-losar.metaTitle: Losar – Gateway to Spiti Valley | India 2022
/travel/india-2022/16-losar.metaDescription: Leaving Chandratal was hard, because the people there had been so friendly to me. That keeps happening to me in India.

/travel/india-2022/17-kaza.metaTitle: Kaza – Heart of Spiti Valley | India 2022
/travel/india-2022/17-kaza.metaDescription: A late morning in Losar, curled up in a blanket, playing chess and writing to people, before carrying on to Kaza.

/travel/india-2022/18-back-to-manali-and.metaDescription: Rekong Peo needed Inner Line Permits I had no time to get, so I turned around and went back the way I had come.

/travel/india-2023/1-jaipur-and-amits-ho.metaTitle: Jaipur & Amit's Home | India 2023 Travel Story
/travel/india-2023/1-jaipur-and-amits-ho.metaDescription: The 2023 India trip starts in Jaipur, the pink city, staying at Amit's home in Rajasthan.

/travel/india-2023/2-in-the-bus-with-ami.metaTitle: Bus Journey with Amit Across India | India 2023
/travel/india-2023/2-in-the-bus-with-ami.metaDescription: A long bus ride with Amit. India feels like it is on the edge of collapse and full of life at once, often in the same street.

/travel/india-2023/3-jammu-and-the-circl.metaTitle: Jammu & the Road to Ladakh | India 2023
/travel/india-2023/3-jammu-and-the-circl.metaDescription: Through Jammu on the way north to Ladakh. Soldiers everywhere, winding roads and the landscape changing as you climb.

/travel/india-2023/4-leh.metaDescription: Leh sits at 3,500 m, so the first days go on acclimatising. Monasteries, and mountains with nothing growing on them.

/travel/india-2023/5-nubra-valley.metaTitle: Nubra Valley – Sand Dunes of Ladakh | India 2023
/travel/india-2023/5-nubra-valley.metaDescription: Over the Khardung La pass and down into the Nubra Valley. Sand dunes and Bactrian camels in a cold high desert.

/travel/india-2023/6-hunder-sand-dunes.metaTitle: Hunder Sand Dunes | Nubra Valley, India 2023
/travel/india-2023/6-hunder-sand-dunes.metaDescription: The dunes at Hunder, at 3,000 m in the Nubra Valley. Double-humped camels walking around a desert that is freezing.

/travel/india-2023/7-markha-valley-trek.metaDescription: The Markha Valley trek in Ladakh. High passes, a few remote villages and mountains at a scale that stops making sense.

/travel/india-2023/8-ahmedabad.metaTitle: Ahmedabad – Step Wells & Old Town | India 2023
/travel/india-2023/8-ahmedabad.metaDescription: Ahmedabad in Gujarat. Step wells, the tangle of the old town and the Sabarmati Ashram where Gandhi used to live.

/travel/india-2023/9-bhuj-and-rann-of-ku.metaTitle: Bhuj & the Rann of Kutch | India 2023
/travel/india-2023/9-bhuj-and-rann-of-ku.metaDescription: Bhuj, and then the Rann of Kutch, a white salt desert that runs to the horizon in every direction you look.

/travel/india-2023/10-mumbai.metaDescription: Back in Mumbai partway through the 2023 trip. Loud, enormous and impossible to be bored in for even a minute.

/travel/india-2023/11-goa.metaDescription: Goa. Beaches, Portuguese churches and about the slowest pace to be found anywhere in India.

/travel/india-2023/12-kerala.metaDescription: Kerala at the end of the 2023 trip. Backwaters, spice gardens and the very green south coast.

/travel/bolivia-2025/salar-de-uyuni.metaDescription: The largest salt flat in the world. Endless white in every direction, and on a wet day no visible line between ground and sky.
